_doc: AI sprite list. size = [w, h] in pixels at 32 px per tile. texture = fill the whole tile (walls, floors). neg = extra negative prompt. own_style = the prompt is complete, the shared style is not added (textures, items that need a plain look).
style: pixel art game sprite, single object, centered, simple readable shapes, thick dark outline, flat colors, post-apocalyptic, plain white background
